title: Italian Companies Dataset
description: Structured Italian company data extracted from aziende.it. Listing mode returns company name, revenue range, ATECO code and location. Optional details mode adds VAT number, address, postal code and employee range when available.

dataset.title: Companies
dataset.description: Dataset containing extracted Italian company records.

categoryKey.title: Requested category
categoryKey.description: Validated category requested by the user or matched through presets.

fatturato.title: Revenue range
fatturato.description: Revenue range as shown by the source.

fatturatoMinEur.title: Revenue min EUR
fatturatoMinEur.description: Parsed lower bound of the revenue range in EUR.

fatturatoMaxEur.title: Revenue max EUR
fatturatoMaxEur.description: Parsed upper bound of the revenue range in EUR.

provincia.title: Province
provincia.description: Italian province where the company is listed.

citta.title: City
citta.description: City where the company is listed.

detailUrl.title: Company detail page
detailUrl.description: Source detail page URL for the company.

partitaIva.title: VAT number
partitaIva.description: Italian VAT number, available when detail enrichment is enabled and the source exposes it.

indirizzo.title: Address
indirizzo.description: Company address, available when detail enrichment is enabled and the source exposes it.

cap.title: Postal code
cap.description: Italian postal code, available when detail enrichment is enabled and the source exposes it.

dipendenti.title: Employees
dipendenti.description: Employee range, available when detail enrichment is enabled and the source exposes it.

telefono.title: Phone
telefono.description: Phone number, rarely available from the source.

email.title: Email
email.description: Email address, rarely available from the source.

pec.title: PEC
pec.description: Certified email address, rarely available from the source.

sitoWeb.title: Website
sitoWeb.description: Company website, rarely available from the source.

dataCostituzione.title: Foundation date
dataCostituzione.description: Foundation or incorporation date, when available.

sourceCategoryUrl.title: Source category URL
sourceCategoryUrl.description: azienda.it category URL used as source.

detailScraped.title: Details included
detailScraped.description: True if detail enrichment was performed for this record.
